#for the NDS data in chap geo_lex_par
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(scales)

folder_path <- "datasets/NDS_dataset"


a_class_data <- read.csv("a_class_dataset.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)
e_class_data <- read.csv("e_class_dataset.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)


#exclude any lexemes that have shift status other than a>a, a>e; e>e; e>a
a_class_clean <- a_class_data %>%
  filter(
    SHIFT_status %in% c("a > a", "a > e"))

e_class_clean <- e_class_data %>%
  filter(
    SHIFT_status %in% c("e > e", "e > a"))

```

```{r}
#geographical patterns

#first for the three broad regions
#create region groupings


a_class_clean <- a_class_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Major_region = case_when(
      County_district %in% c("Oestfold", "Vestfold", "Aust_Telemark", "Vest_Telemark") ~ "Eastern",
      County_district %in% c("Romsdal", "Nordmoere", "Soer_Troendelag_Austdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Vestdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Fosen")  ~ "Northern",
      County_district %in% c("Vest_Agder", "Dalane_og_Jaeren", "Austre_Ryfylke", "Nordre_Ryfylke", "Sunnhordland", "Nordhordland", "Midhordland_Hardanger_Voss", "Sogn_og_Fjordane", "Sunnmoere") ~ "Western",
      TRUE                                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

e_class_clean <- e_class_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Major_region = case_when(
      County_district %in% c("Oestfold", "Vestfold", "Aust_Telemark", "Vest_Telemark") ~ "Eastern",
      County_district %in% c("Romsdal", "Nordmoere", "Soer_Troendelag_Austdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Vestdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Fosen")  ~ "Northern",
      County_district %in% c("Vest_Agder", "Dalane_og_Jaeren", "Austre_Ryfylke", "Nordre_Ryfylke", "Sunnhordland", "Nordhordland", "Midhordland_Hardanger_Voss", "Sogn_og_Fjordane", "Sunnmoere") ~ "Western",
      TRUE                                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

#shift status within a-class by major region

region_shift_overview_a <- a_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Major_region, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),            
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Major_region) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs   = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs    = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#shift status within e-class by major region

region_shift_overview_e <- e_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Major_region, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),            
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Major_region) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs   = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs    = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# now for count/district by region

#create the groupings -- Sør Trøndelag and Ryfylke need to be joined from smaller areas

a_class_clean <- a_class_clean %>%
  mutate(
    County_district = case_when(
      County_district %in% c("Austre_Ryfylke", "Nordre_Ryfylke") ~ "Ryfylke",
      County_district %in% c("Soer_Troendelag_Austdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Vestdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Fosen") ~ "Soer_Troendelag",
      TRUE                                       ~ County_district
    )
  )

e_class_clean <- e_class_clean %>%
  mutate(
    County_district = case_when(
      County_district %in% c("Austre_Ryfylke", "Nordre_Ryfylke") ~ "Ryfylke",
      County_district %in% c("Soer_Troendelag_Austdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Vestdalane", "Soer_Troendelag_Fosen") ~ "Soer_Troendelag",
      TRUE                                       ~ County_district
    )
  )


#a-class
county_shift_overview_a <- a_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Major_region, County_district, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Major_region, County_district) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#e-class

county_shift_overview_e <- e_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Major_region, County_district, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Major_region, County_district) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#by dialect area
#a-class

dialect_shift_overview_a <- a_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#e-class

dialect_shift_overview_e <- e_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#lexical patterns

#make a lexeme status overview

#a-class
lexeme_patterns_global_a <- a_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Lexeme, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


#e-class
lexeme_patterns_global_e <- e_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Lexeme, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Lexeme) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs      = sum(n_obs),
    prop_of_lexeme = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#visualization lexical patterns

#
global_a_per_lexeme <- a_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Lexeme, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Lexeme_label = dplyr::case_when(
      Lexeme == "kasta" ~ "kasta 'throw'",
      Lexeme == "kosta" ~ "kosta 'cost'",
      Lexeme == "tapa"  ~ "tapa 'lose'",
      Lexeme == "lika"  ~ "lika 'like'",
      Lexeme == "lova"  ~ "lova 'promise'",
      Lexeme == "baka"  ~ "baka 'bake'",
      Lexeme == "maala"  ~ "m\u00e5la 'paint'",
      Lexeme == "bora"  ~ "bora 'drill'",
      Lexeme == "laga"  ~ "laga 'make'",
      Lexeme == "kalla" ~ "kalla 'call, name'",
      Lexeme == "takka" ~ "takka 'thank'",
      Lexeme == "fiska" ~ "fiska 'fish'"
    )
  )


#orders lexeme by shift proportion
global_a_per_lexeme <- global_a_per_lexeme %>%
  group_by(Lexeme_label) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_shift = ifelse(
      any(SHIFT_status == "a > e"),
      prop_obs[SHIFT_status == "a > e"],
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Lexeme_label = reorder(Lexeme_label, prop_shift)
  )


ggplot(global_a_per_lexeme,
       aes(x = Lexeme_label,
           y = prop_obs,
           fill = SHIFT_status)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_obs),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("a > a" = "#BDBDBD", "a > e" = "#2F2F2F")) +
  labs(
    x   = "Lexeme",
    y   = "Percentage of paradigms",
    fill = "Shift status"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)


#now for e-verbs

global_e_per_lexeme <- e_class_clean %>%
  group_by(Lexeme, SHIFT_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Lexeme_label = dplyr::case_when(
      Lexeme == "kjenna" ~ "kjenna 'know, feel'",
      Lexeme == "nemna" ~ "nemna 'name'",
      Lexeme == "hoeyra"  ~ "h\u00f8yra 'hear, listen'",
      Lexeme == "moeta"  ~ "m\u00f8ta 'meet'",
      Lexeme == "kjoepa"  ~ "kj\u00f8pa 'buy'",
      Lexeme == "gloeyma"  ~ "gl\u00f8yma 'forget'",
      Lexeme == "fylgja"  ~ "fylgja 'follow'",
      Lexeme == "senda"  ~ "senda 'send'",
      Lexeme == "boeya"  ~ "b\u00f8ya 'bend'",
      Lexeme == "bloeyta" ~ "bl\u00f8yta 'wet'",
      Lexeme == "ploeya" ~ "pl\u00f8ya 'plough'",
      Lexeme == "noeya" ~ "n\u00f8ya 'be content, settle with'",
      Lexeme == "toeya" ~ "t\u00f8ya 'stretch'",
      Lexeme == "syrgja" ~ "syrgja 'sorrow, mourn'"
    )
  )


global_e_per_lexeme <- global_e_per_lexeme %>%
  group_by(Lexeme_label) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_shift = ifelse(
      any(SHIFT_status == "e > a"),
      prop_obs[SHIFT_status == "e > a"],
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Lexeme_label = reorder(Lexeme_label, prop_shift)
  )

global_e_per_lexeme %>%
  distinct(Lexeme_label, prop_shift) %>%
  arrange(desc(prop_shift))

ggplot(global_e_per_lexeme,
       aes(x = Lexeme_label,
           y = prop_obs,
           fill = SHIFT_status)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_obs),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("e > e" = "#BDBDBD", "e > a" = "#2F2F2F")) +
  labs(
    x   = "Lexeme",
    y   = "Percentage of paradigms",
    fill = "Shift status"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
#here starts the paradigmatic analysis
#cell-level

#a-class
#first, exclude paradigms that have nid or a/nid values

#identify such paradigms
paradigms_exclude <- a_class_data %>%
  group_by(Dialect_point, Lexeme) %>%
  filter(any(str_detect(MN_class, "nid"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(Dialect_point, Lexeme)


#keep the ones that have a relevant shift, and exclude the ones with nid
a_no_nid_paradigms <- a_class_data %>%
  anti_join(paradigms_exclude, by = c("Dialect_point", "Lexeme"))

paradigms_with_relevant_shift <- a_no_nid_paradigms %>%
  filter(Cell == "present",
         SHIFT_status %in% c("a > a", "a > e")) %>%
  distinct(Dialect_point, Lexeme)

a_cells_paradigm <- a_no_nid_paradigms %>%
  semi_join(paradigms_with_relevant_shift, by = c("Dialect_point", "Lexeme")) %>%
  filter(MN_class %in% c("a", "e", "doubl a/e")) %>%
  mutate(
    MN_shift = case_when(
      MN_class == "a" ~ "a > a",
      MN_class %in% c("e", "doubl a/e") ~ "a > e"
    )
  )

cell_overview_a <- a_cells_paradigm %>%
  group_by(Cell, MN_shift) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Cell) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


#now the same for the e-class data
#identify paradigms to exclude
paradigms_exclude_e <- e_class_data %>%
  group_by(Dialect_point, Lexeme) %>%
  filter(any(str_detect(MN.class, "nid"))) %>%   # if ANY row has nid
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(Dialect_point, Lexeme)


#now only keep the ones that have a relevant shift, and exclude the ones with nid
e_no_nid_paradigms <- e_class_data %>%
  anti_join(paradigms_exclude_e, by = c("Dialect_point", "Lexeme"))

paradigms_with_relevant_shift_e <- e_no_nid_paradigms %>%
  filter(Cell == "present",
         SHIFT_status %in% c("e > e", "e > a")) %>%
  distinct(Dialect_point, Lexeme)

e_cells_paradigm <- e_no_nid_paradigms %>%
  semi_join(paradigms_with_relevant_shift_e, by = c("Dialect_point", "Lexeme")) %>%
  filter(MN.class %in% c("a", "e", "doubl a/e")) %>%
  mutate(
    MN_shift = case_when(
      MN.class == "e" ~ "e > e",
      MN.class %in% c("a", "doubl a/e") ~ "e > a"
    )
  )

cell_overview_e <- e_cells_paradigm %>%
  group_by(Cell, MN_shift) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Cell) %>%
  mutate(
    total_obs = sum(n_obs),
    prop_obs  = n_obs / total_obs
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```


```{r}
#visualization for cell-level analysis

#a-class

ggplot(cell_overview_a,
       aes(x = Cell, y = prop_obs, fill = MN_shift)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", colour = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_obs),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            colour = "white",
            size   = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("a > a" = "#BDBDBD", "a > e" = "#2F2F2F"),
    name   = "Shift status"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Paradigm cell",
    y = "Percentage of forms"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

#e-class

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("e > e" = "#BDBDBD", "e > a" = "#2F2F2F"),

  ) +

  )
```
